title: Filed Makeup Advance by Financial Responsibility Filing — Installment Payment Plans
content:
| Owner Auto Policy term's financial responsibility filing | Added to the makeup of a returned payment |
|---|---|
| FR-44 (written to back an FR-44 certificate) | 10 percent of the returned amount |
| SR-22 (written to back an SR-22 certificate) | 5 percent of the returned amount |
| none (backs no certificate) | nothing |

This schedule of the **Installment Payment Plans** applies to the makeup of a payment returned on a plan billing an Owner Auto Policy term. The returned amount is the total returned against the returned payment. The filing is read from the Owner Auto Policy term's own record of the certificate it is written to back.

*Hypothetical reading.* A returned amount of 210.00 on a plan whose owner term is written to back an SR-22 certificate: 5 percent, 10.50, is added; an FR-44 term would add 21.00.
